svg.title: Home schema
svg.desc: Per-user preferences as the hub of the home schema of the workspace database: the Needs You read model (home_items), the activity feed, the daily brief cache, the notification inbox with its instant push queue, Web Push subscriptions and throttle, reminders, and the projected workspace settings that preferences fall back to. No foreign keys are declared: every line is a by-value link.
svg.text: NOTE no foreign keys are declared in this schema; every line is a by-value link on user_id (or on the singleton for workspace_settings)
NOT DRAWN outbox, processed_events, dead_events (standard shapes) · notify_channels / notify_links / notify_link_codes were dropped in 006
